en-US.title: BoxHockeyTastic
en-US.subtitle: Tabletop Box Hockey. No Ads.
en-US.promoText: Flick the puck through the gaps and into the other player's goal. Play the CPU or a friend across the table, with no ads and no tracking.
en-US.description:
Physics-driven tabletop box hockey. Flick the puck through the gaps and into the other player's goal, against the CPU or a friend across the table. No ads, no accounts.

• One Player against the CPU (Easy, Medium, or Hard), or Two Player face to face on one device
• Take turns shooting, and choose how you shoot, from a fast flick to a slingshot pull
• Three tip-offs: a Face-Off reaction race, a Coin Flip, or Triple Tap
• Three boards: Classic, Gauntlet, and Gravity, plus a Rink option with rounded corners and a net behind each goal
• Set the puck speed, the puck size, and the score to win
• Player profiles, stats, and 33 achievements
• Plays offline

Part of the Tastic family of games. Your player profiles are shared with the other Tastic games on your device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/BoxHockey
